review_evidence: ViewGraphs.lean alone contains a large theorem development for view subgraphs, adjacency, lattice operations, supports, edge sets, maps and inclusions.

The remaining primary modules define graph basics, labelling problems, LOCAL/port-numbering models, covering maps and PN networks; experiment modules are formal Lean developments rather than external test harnesses.
Import/navigation roots are already FD-016 and intentionally retained; nonformal project metadata is already filtered generically.
summary: Reviewed DGAlgorithms; retain all 13 primary Lean files as distributed-algorithms/graph-theory formalization, including experiment modules.
